title: scene-00: no cross-operator region entry
description: Found while citing OpenSimulator Hypergrid (jmap-chat-spec-9k91). Scene admits a user to a region only via shared access to the hosting account on the same JMAP server (account-model). Hypergrid lets an avatar from one operator's grid teleport into another operator's region, admitted by the destination's Gatekeeper, with identity staying at the home grid. Scene has no way for a user of server A to enter a region hosted on server B. Decide: out of scope for -00 (say so), or design entry over the federation draft (visitor identity, admission, SceneAvatar for a remote user). Related: portals/world-graphs are application-layer per jmap-chat-spec-pdya.
